title: Stochastic Mirror Descent under Iterate-Dependent Markov Noise: Analysis in the Asymptotic and Finite Time Regimes
summary: We study a stochastic optimization problem in which the sampling distribution depends on the decision variable, and the available samples are generated through an iterate-dependent Markov chain. Such settings arise naturally in problems with decision-dependent uncertainty; however, they introduce bias and temporal dependence, which render standard techniques developed for i.i.d.\ noise inapplicable.
